end.parentNote: Asha practised counting sides and corners, including shapes shown tilted or in different positions. Ayaan used a one-by-one counting method and correctly explained that a triangle still has three sides and corners when tilted. They first mixed up a tilted triangle with four sides, then corrected it by recounting the corners and sides. At home, ask Ayaan to draw or find tilted shapes and count each side and corner aloud.
